name: THE ANGEL'S TAPES
source:
Becky Barlett, starry-eyed Philly party girl, strolls into a gun store owned by one Maddison Wendi Thompson, rugged and fierce gun nut woman, to ask for her advice in hunting an abomination that she has chased to this small town. 

Ever the easily fascinated, Maddy might soon come to regret following Becky down, down and down a monstrous girl-shaped hole through the fabric of reality and into the jaws of the shadowed powers that flit about this strange head-in-the-clouds dame.

A found footage-inspired Appalchian horror yuri visual novel about girls hunting a cryptid deep in the woods of Pennsyltucky, and the haunting cosmic tragedy unraveled by their search.

[Edited from [url=https://dianerds.itch.io/angels-tapes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
满怀憧憬的费城派对女孩贝琪·巴利特，大步走进了硬朗彪悍的枪械狂热女老板麦迪逊·温蒂·汤普森经营的枪店，向她请教该如何猎杀自己一路追踪到这座小镇的某头可憎怪物。

向来容易被新奇事物吸引的麦迪，恐怕很快就会后悔自己跟着贝琪一路向下、越陷越深，穿过撕裂现实帷幕的怪诞少女形孔洞，一步步跌入萦绕在这位古怪空想少女身畔的暗影邪力之口。

这是一部受伪纪录片风格启发的阿巴拉契亚恐怖百合视觉小说，讲述了少女们在宾夕法尼亚偏远山林深处猎捕神秘生物，并随着搜寻一步步揭开骇人宇宙悲剧的故事。

[摘自[url=https://dianerds.itch.io/angels-tapes]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
